body:
T278 bounded prerequisite over main f1cfcfc. Product direction is approved in .adlc/specs/62-bound-renderer-activation.md. Extract the current live bound authority checks without changing behavior or enabling any renderer door.

Add src/gateway/connection-authority.ts with connectionStands(gateway: Gateway, binding: ConnectionBinding): boolean and boundChannelAdmits(gateway: Gateway, binding: ConnectionBinding, channel: ChannelStatus): boolean. Preserve the existing HTTP checks exactly: connectionStands checks the entire container parent chain then openerStands for the bound container/inbox. boundChannelAdmits requires connectionStands, exact openedFrom matching binding.inbox, openerStands(channel), and receivesNow of the current container table/channel destination. It must not cache authority or write deltas. HTTP imports the shared functions; its unbound federateAdmits branch remains unchanged. No renderer activation, root serving, data-scope or public API change belongs here.

Author test/gateway/connection-authority.test.ts first. Use real gateways and signed declarations/grants, reusing exported connection fixtures if useful, not mocked authority. Test standing binding with live admitted channel; wrong opening inbox/unbound source refused; revoked connection fails on next check while a separate connection remains authorized; ancestor removal fails; receive leeway withdrawal fails; probes append nothing. Preserve existing server subtree/channel controls. Baseline controls are expected green; new API absence is an honest module-extraction red, not a newly discovered behavior defect. Measure and freeze the new rail only after authoring. Verification: new test plus test/server/connection-container.test.ts, test/server/subtree-receive.test.ts and test/server/leeway.test.ts; typecheck/lint and relevant full checks.

T263 already-landed mechanics are the baseline, not a dependency on its still-open parent completion. This extraction feeds T278 renderer-context/activation work; T274 may later generalize the boundary. Full T278 remains incomplete until scoped serving, durability, exact identity and revocation are implemented and reviewed.

Independent P1 review requires an otherwise-valid binding and matching openedFrom with an incompatible openedBy, isolating the channel opener check. Compare primary and all attached inbox histories around positive and refused probes. Authored rail SHA256: 37d99788b0285556a7aeb538071f4136bc04e0a6c760087c87c474b98ad93fdf. Measured red is missing shared module, not absent existing HTTP semantics.
title: Extract live bound connection and channel authority for renderer contexts
